name: Scenario AP: Daily Waitlist Manager
comments: Scheduled daily at 8AM ET. Checks Google Calendar for any same-day openings (events cancelled or slots free today), searches HubSpot for contacts with waitlist=true, generates personalised AI outreach emails for the top 5, sends via Resend, and logs HubSpot notes. Error route sends an internal alert via Resend. All secrets stored as env.VARIABLE_NAME. Timezone: America/New_York.

metadata.notes: Runs once every 24 hours. Configure Make.com schedule to run at 8:00 AM America/New_York. Interval 86400 = 24 hours in seconds.
Retrieves all events for today in Eastern Time. The list is passed to Claude so it can identify truly open windows vs. blocked slots. The scenario proceeds regardless of how many events are found.

notes.label: Module 1 — Daily Schedule Trigger
notes.note: Runs every morning at 8:00 AM Eastern Time. Set the Make.com scenario schedule to 8AM America/New_York in the scenario scheduling panel.

notes.label: Modules 2–4 — Calendar Scan + Slot Extraction
notes.note: Lists all Google Calendar events for today, passes them to Claude (module 3) to identify open 60+ minute windows between 8AM and 6PM ET, parses the JSON result (module 4). If no slots exist the open_slots array is empty but outreach is still sent with the Calendly link.

notes.label: Modules 5–9 — Waitlist Fetch + Personalised Outreach Loop
notes.note: Fetches top 5 oldest waitlisted HubSpot contacts (module 5), iterates via BasicFeeder (module 6), Claude writes a personalised email for each (module 7), Resend delivers it (module 8), HubSpot note logged per contact (module 9).
